record.name: Egypt
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. A planned AI safety and security centre for universities supports research and registers high-risk AI used in higher education, without a model-evaluation mandate.

next_check.reason: Routine re-check on a two-year rotation of states with no reported plans.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. The retrieved material does not sufficiently establish the national AI governance arrangements. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

Re-ran searches in English and Arabic for a government-designated institute that evaluates advanced models, or a commitment, proposal or study naming one. No qualifying institute or commitment was identified; results described the National AI Council's governance instruments and strategy work. Retrieved the communications ministry's AI page as new primary governance evidence. Raised confidence to medium under the status-confidence rule: recorded queries in English and a national or official language, and cited primary governance evidence consistent with no qualifying institute. Partial check; the last full-check date is unchanged.

searches.query: مصر معهد سلامة الذكاء الاصطناعي استراتيجية وطنية
Egypt AI safety institute model evaluation government National Council for AI 2026
مصر معهد سلامة الذكاء الاصطناعي تقييم النماذج المجلس الوطني للذكاء الاصطناعي 2026

check.language_note: The recorded ar query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: EG-search = searches 1, 2 (en, ar). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger. On 24 October 2026 the record was searched again in English and Arabic; the result links of each query were matched against registered sources in the same way.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The communications ministry's AI page describes the National Council for AI, set up in 2019, as the highest body steering AI policy and governance, with duties that include ethical principles, governance policies and standards for AI use. The listed duties include no evaluation of advanced models. The state repository records the second national AI strategy.

related_bodies.name: AI Safety and Security Centre in Higher Education
related_bodies.role: Its proposed remit covers research, training and a register of high-risk AI in the sector. The Academy of Scientific Research and Technology called for proposals for the centre in March 2025.

related_bodies.name: National Council for AI
related_bodies.role: It oversees the national AI strategy 2025-2030.

record.notes: An official release records the national AI strategy's second edition on 22 January 2025. The higher-education safety-centre proposal remains supported by Masrawy's account; independent primary confirmation was not retrieved. The second strategy edition covers 2025-2030. Searches covered indexed public English and Arabic sources for a government-designated AI safety institute with a remit to evaluate advanced models.
